_about: Curated disease targets linked to RetiLink findings. Roles summarise textbook biology; drug lists come from ChEMBL (chembl_drugs.json, scripts/fetch_structures.py). Structures: AlphaFold DB (CC-BY 4.0) and RCSB PDB.

targets.name: Vascular endothelial growth factor A
targets.role: Hypoxic retina releases VEGF-A, which makes vessels leak (macular edema) and drives new fragile vessels (proliferative DR).
targets.eye_link: Referable DR and the macular edema signal are the retinal phenotype of VEGF-driven disease.

complex.title: VEGF-A bound by an affinity-matured antibody Fab (the lineage of ranibizumab)

targets.name: Angiopoietin-2
targets.role: Destabilises vessels and sensitises them to VEGF; the second arm of bispecific therapy for macular edema.

targets.name: Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor alpha
targets.role: Nuclear receptor controlling lipid metabolism; its agonist fenofibrate slowed DR progression in trials (FIELD, ACCORD-Eye, LENS).
targets.eye_link: Non-proliferative DR in a patient with diabetes.

targets.name: Protein kinase C beta
targets.role: Hyperglycaemia activates PKC-beta, increasing retinal vascular permeability; inhibitors were studied for DR.
targets.eye_link: Diabetic microvascular damage seen in the retina.

targets.name: Angiotensin II receptor type 1
targets.role: Mediates angiotensin II vasoconstriction; blocked by sartans. RAS blockade lowers blood pressure and protects kidneys.
targets.eye_link: Retinal arteriolar narrowing mirrors blood pressure; hypertension signal.

targets.name: Angiotensin-converting enzyme
targets.role: Converts angiotensin I to angiotensin II; ACE inhibitors are first-line for hypertension with albuminuria in diabetes.

targets.name: Sodium/glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2)
targets.role: Reabsorbs glucose in the kidney; SGLT2 inhibitors lower glucose and protect kidney and heart in diabetes.
targets.eye_link: Retinal microvascular disease shares its cause with diabetic kidney disease.

targets.name: Mineralocorticoid receptor
targets.role: Drives inflammation and fibrosis in kidney and heart; non-steroidal antagonist finerenone slows diabetic kidney disease.

targets.name: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor
targets.role: Incretin receptor; agonists lower glucose and weight and reduce cardiovascular events. Rapid glucose lowering can transiently worsen DR.
targets.eye_link: Diabetes duration and control; retinopathy status matters before starting.

targets.name: Aldose reductase
targets.role: First enzyme of the polyol pathway; sorbitol build-up damages nerves and retinal pericytes in hyperglycaemia.
targets.eye_link: Neuropathy signal; polyol pathway damage is shared by retina and nerves.

targets.name: Voltage-gated calcium channel subunit alpha-2/delta-1
targets.role: Target of gabapentinoids used for painful diabetic neuropathy.
